legend: Your friend, Mikey, has had issues recently; every week he gets food poisoning. Mikey is pretty sure that the food poisoning is from exactly one restaurant; he doesn't know which one though. Mikey wants to devise a strategy to find out. He wants to find out as quickly as possible (least number of weeks).

Mikey is willing to eat at a subset of his usual restaurants each week to find the bad restaurant (the subset can be as small or as large as needed). However, Mikey doesn't want to get food poisoning too many times, so he wants to find the bad restaurant while getting poisoned at most p times.

Note that if Mikey eats at a subset of restaurants in a given week and gets food poisoning, then the bad restaurant is in that subset; if he doesn't get food poisoning, then the bad restaurant is not in that subset. Note also that the subset of restaurants for different weeks do not have to be the same size.

Given the number of restaurants and the maximum allowable number of times to get food poisoning, determine (in the worst case) the least number of weeks needed to find out which restaurant is giving Mikey food poisoning.
input: There is only one input line; it contains two integers: n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤100,000)$$$(1 ≤ n ≤ 100,000)$$$, indicating the number of restaurants, and p$$$p$$$ (1≤p≤10,000)$$$(1 ≤ p ≤ 10,000)$$$, indicating the maximum number of times Mikey is willing to get food poisoning.
output: Print the least number of weeks Mikey will need to eat before definitively determining which restaurant is giving him food poisoning, given an optimum strategy, but worst luck. Note that there will always be an answer.
note: Explanation of the First Sample Input/Output:

Mikey can eat in one restaurant each week; that will tell him if that restaurant is causing the food poisoning. After at most 7 weeks, he will know the bad restaurant since there are only 8 restaurants.

legend.ai: 你的朋友 Mikey 最近遇到了一些麻烦；他每周都会食物中毒。Mikey 很确定导致食物中毒的恰好是一家餐厅，只是他不知道是哪一家。Mikey 想制定一个策略来找出这家餐厅。他希望尽快找出答案（所需周数最少）。
Mikey 愿意每周在他平时光顾的餐厅中的一个子集里用餐，以找出有问题的餐厅（该子集可以根据需要任意小或任意大）。不过，Mikey 不想中毒太多次，因此他希望在中毒次数不超过 p 次的情况下找出有问题的餐厅。
注意，如果 Mikey 在某一周在一组餐厅中用餐并且食物中毒了，那么有问题的餐厅就在这一子集中；如果他没有食物中毒，那么有问题的餐厅就不在这一子集中。还要注意，不同周所选餐厅子集的大小不必相同。
给定餐厅的数量以及允许食物中毒的最大次数，求在最坏情况下确定是哪家餐厅让 Mikey 食物中毒所需的最少周数。

output.ai: 输出在采用最优策略但运气最差的情况下，Mikey 在确定是哪家餐厅让他食物中毒之前需要进食的最少周数。注意，答案总是存在。

note.ai: 第一组输入/输出样例的解释：
Mikey 每周可以在一家餐厅用餐，这样就能得知该餐厅是否导致了食物中毒。最多 7 周后，他就能知道是哪家餐厅有问题，因为只有 8 家餐厅。
